claim: One-choose protection in the CloudFront console creates an AWS WAF web ACL, configures rules to protect your servers from common web threats, and attaches the web ACL to the CloudFront distribution for you; you can also use a preconfigured web ACL that you create in the AWS WAF console or with the AWS WAF APIs.

evidence.quote: Use one-choose protection in the CloudFront console. One-choose protection creates an AWS WAF web access control list (web ACL), configures rules to protect your servers from common web threats, and attaches the web ACL to the CloudFront distribution for you. The topics in this section assume the use of one-choose protections.
Use a preconfigured web ACL (access control list) that you create in the AWS WAF console, or by using the AWS WAF APIs.

note: d082 adjudicate-15: the guide text calls the console option one-choose protection (the console button is one-click protection).
